dedupe_keys.name: a 500 m crop water requirement and irrigation water demand dataset for 25 crop types in the yellow river basin 2000 2020

description: Shizhen Tang and Hongbo Zhang publish annual water-demand estimates for 25 crop types in China's Yellow River Basin from 2000 to 2020. Four ZIP downloads supply approximately 500-metre WGS84 GeoTIFF grids. The February 2026 deposit is free under CC BY 4.0. Its CWR variable is crop evapotranspiration minus effective precipitation, equivalent to a net irrigation requirement, while IWD divides that deficit by irrigation efficiency to estimate gross withdrawals. Separate versions cover all sown cropland or only areas mapped as actually irrigated. Pixel values use millimetres per year. The model combines Penman-Monteith estimates, crop coefficients from 45 stations, provincial efficiency values and spatial crop allocation. These layers can drive irrigation-network demand simulations, but theoretical deficits across rainfed land should not be treated as actual abstractions. Approximate angular cell size varies in physical area with latitude. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies these products, and raster values were not checked.
